name: Pitest

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
  pull_request:
    branches: '*'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:
    if: github.repository == 'checkstyle/checkstyle'
    strategy:
      matrix:
        profile:
          - annotation
          - ant
          - api
          - blocks
          - coding-1
          - coding-2
          - coding-require-this-check
          - common
          - common-2
          - design
          - filters
          - header
          - imports
          - indentation
          - javadoc
          - main
          - metrics
          - misc
          - modifier
          - naming
          - packagenamesloader
          - regexp
          - sizes
          - tree-walker
          - utils
          - whitespace
          - xpath
          - java-ast-visitor
          # GUI package needs better test coverage before adding to execution.
          # - gui
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Set up JDK 11
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: 11
          distribution: 'temurin'

      - name: Install groovy
        run: |
          sudo apt update
          sudo apt install groovy

      - name: Setup local maven cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.m2/repository
          key: checkstyle-maven-cache-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}

      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Generate pitest-${{ matrix.profile }} report
        run: |
          ./.ci/pitest.sh "pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}"

      - name: Patch command for pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}
        if: failure()
        run: |
          printf "\nTo patch suppression list run:\n\n"
          GIT_DIFF=$(git diff)
          printf "patch -p1 << EOF\n%s\nEOF" "$GIT_DIFF"
          exit 1

      - name: Stage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        run: |
          mkdir staging && cp -r target/pit-reports/ staging
          git diff && git diff > target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch

      - name: Archive code coverage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}-coverage-report
          path: |
            staging
            target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Patch command for pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}
        if: failure()
        run: |
          printf "\nTo patch suppression list run:\n\n"
          GIT_DIFF=$(git diff)
          printf "patch -p1 << EOF\n%s\nEOF" "$GIT_DIFF"
          exit 1

      - name: Stage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        run: |
          mkdir staging && cp -r target/pit-reports/ staging
          git diff && git diff > target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch

      - name: Archive code coverage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}-coverage-report
          path: |
            staging
            target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch
          retention-days: 7

name: Pitest

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
  pull_request:
    branches: '*'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:

    if: github.repository == 'checkstyle/checkstyle'

      matrix:
        profile:
          - annotation
          - ant
          - api
          - blocks
          - coding-1
          - coding-2
          - coding-require-this-check
          - common
          - common-2
          - design
          - filters
          - header
          - imports
          - indentation
          - javadoc
          - main
          - metrics
          - misc
          - modifier
          - naming
          - packagenamesloader

          - sizes

          - utils
          - whitespace
          - xpath

          # GUI package needs better test coverage before adding to execution.

    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Set up JDK 11
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: 11
          distribution: 'temurin'

      - name: Install groovy
        run: |
          sudo apt update
          sudo apt install groovy

      - name: Setup local maven cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.m2/repository
          key: checkstyle-maven-cache-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}

      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Generate pitest-${{ matrix.profile }} report
        run: |
          ./.ci/pitest.sh "pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}"

      - name: Patch command for pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}
        if: failure()
        run: |
          printf "\nTo patch suppression list run:\n\n"
          GIT_DIFF=$(git diff)
          printf "patch -p1 << EOF\n%s\nEOF" "$GIT_DIFF"
          exit 1

      - name: Stage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        run: |
          mkdir staging && cp -r target/pit-reports/ staging
          git diff && git diff > target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch

      - name: Archive code coverage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}-coverage-report
          path: |
            staging
            target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch
          retention-days: 7

name: Pitest

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master

    branches: '*'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}

jobs:

        profile:
          - annotation
          - ant
          - api
          - blocks
          - coding-1
          - coding-2
          - coding-require-this-check
          - common
          - common-2
          - design
          - filters
          - header
          - imports
          - indentation
          - javadoc
          - main
          - metrics
          - misc
          - modifier

        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: 11
          distribution: 'temurin'

        with:

        if: failure()

        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        run: |
          mkdir staging && cp -r target/pit-reports/ staging

      - name: Archive code coverage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}-coverage-report
          path: |

name: Pitest

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
  pull_request:
    branches: '*'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:
    if: github.repository == 'checkstyle/checkstyle'
    strategy:
      matrix:
        profile:
          - annotation
          - ant
          - api
          - blocks
          - coding-1
          - coding-2
          - coding-require-this-check
          - common
          - common-2
          - design
          - filters
          - header
          - imports
          - indentation
          - javadoc
          - main
          - metrics
          - misc
          - modifier
          - naming
          - packagenamesloader
          - regexp
          - sizes
          - tree-walker
          - utils
          - whitespace
          - xpath
          - java-ast-visitor
          # GUI package needs better test coverage before adding to execution.
          # - gui
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Set up JDK 11
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: 11
          distribution: 'temurin'

      - name: Install groovy
        run: |
          sudo apt update
          sudo apt install groovy

      - name: Setup local maven cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.m2/repository
          key: checkstyle-maven-cache-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}

      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Generate pitest-${{ matrix.profile }} report
        run: |
          ./.ci/pitest.sh "pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}"

      - name: Patch command for pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}
        if: failure()
        run: |
          printf "\nTo patch suppression list run:\n\n"
          GIT_DIFF=$(git diff)
          printf "patch -p1 << EOF\n%s\nEOF" "$GIT_DIFF"
          exit 1

      - name: Stage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        run: |
          mkdir staging && cp -r target/pit-reports/ staging
          git diff && git diff > target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch

      - name: Archive code coverage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}-coverage-report
          path: |
            staging
            target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch
          retention-days: 7

name: Pitest

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
  pull_request:
    branches: '*'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:
    if: github.repository == 'checkstyle/checkstyle'
    strategy:
      matrix:
        profile:
          - annotation
          - ant
          - api
          - blocks
          - coding-1
          - coding-2
          - coding-require-this-check
          - common
          - common-2
          - design
          - filters
          - header
          - imports
          - indentation
          - javadoc
          - main
          - metrics
          - misc
          - modifier
          - naming
          - packagenamesloader
          - regexp
          - sizes
          - tree-walker
          - utils
          - whitespace
          - xpath
          - java-ast-visitor
          # GUI package needs better test coverage before adding to execution.
          # - gui
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Set up JDK 11
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: 11
          distribution: 'temurin'

      - name: Install groovy
        run: |
          sudo apt update
          sudo apt install groovy

      - name: Setup local maven cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.m2/repository
          key: checkstyle-maven-cache-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}

      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Generate pitest-${{ matrix.profile }} report
        run: |
          ./.ci/pitest.sh "pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}"

      - name: Patch command for pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}
        if: failure()
        run: |
          printf "\nTo patch suppression list run:\n\n"
          GIT_DIFF=$(git diff)
          printf "patch -p1 << EOF\n%s\nEOF" "$GIT_DIFF"
          exit 1

      - name: Stage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        run: |
          mkdir staging && cp -r target/pit-reports/ staging
          git diff && git diff > target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch

      - name: Archive code coverage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}-coverage-report
          path: |
            staging
            target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch
          retention-days: 7

name: Pitest

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
  pull_request:
    branches: '*'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:
    if: github.repository == 'checkstyle/checkstyle'
    strategy:
      matrix:
        profile:
          - annotation
          - ant
          - api
          - blocks
          - coding-1
          - coding-2
          - coding-require-this-check
          - common
          - common-2
          - design
          - filters
          - header
          - imports
          - indentation
          - javadoc
          - main
          - metrics
          - misc
          - modifier
          - naming
          - packagenamesloader
          - regexp
          - sizes
          - tree-walker
          - utils
          - whitespace
          - xpath
          - java-ast-visitor
          # GUI package needs better test coverage before adding to execution.
          # - gui
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Set up JDK 11
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: 11
          distribution: 'temurin'

      - name: Install groovy
        run: |
          sudo apt update
          sudo apt install groovy

      - name: Setup local maven cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.m2/repository
          key: checkstyle-maven-cache-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}

      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Generate pitest-${{ matrix.profile }} report
        run: |
          ./.ci/pitest.sh "pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}"

      - name: Patch command for pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}
        if: failure()
        run: |
          printf "\nTo patch suppression list run:\n\n"
          GIT_DIFF=$(git diff)
          printf "patch -p1 << EOF\n%s\nEOF" "$GIT_DIFF"
          exit 1

      - name: Stage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        run: |
          mkdir staging && cp -r target/pit-reports/ staging
          git diff && git diff > target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch

      - name: Archive code coverage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}-coverage-report
          path: |
            staging
            target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch
          retention-days: 7

name: Pitest

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
  pull_request:
    branches: '*'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:
    if: github.repository == 'checkstyle/checkstyle'
    strategy:
      matrix:
        profile:
          - annotation
          - ant
          - api
          - blocks
          - coding-1
          - coding-2
          - coding-require-this-check
          - common
          - common-2
          - design
          - filters
          - header
          - imports
          - indentation
          - javadoc
          - main
          - metrics
          - misc
          - modifier
          - naming
          - packagenamesloader
          - regexp
          - sizes
          - tree-walker
          - utils
          - whitespace
          - xpath
          - java-ast-visitor
          # GUI package needs better test coverage before adding to execution.
          # - gui
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Set up JDK 11
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: 11
          distribution: 'temurin'

      - name: Install groovy
        run: |
          sudo apt update
          sudo apt install groovy

      - name: Setup local maven cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.m2/repository
          key: checkstyle-maven-cache-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}

      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Generate pitest-${{ matrix.profile }} report
        run: |
          ./.ci/pitest.sh "pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}"

      - name: Patch command for pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}
        if: failure()
        run: |
          printf "\nTo patch suppression list run:\n\n"
          GIT_DIFF=$(git diff)
          printf "patch -p1 << EOF\n%s\nEOF" "$GIT_DIFF"
          exit 1

      - name: Stage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        run: |
          mkdir staging && cp -r target/pit-reports/ staging
          git diff && git diff > target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch

      - name: Archive code coverage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}-coverage-report
          path: |
            staging
            target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch
          retention-days: 7

on:

on:

          - common

        uses: actions/setup-java@v4

      - name: Checkout

        run: |
          ./.ci/pitest.sh "pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}"

      - name: Patch command for pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}
        if: failure()
        run: |
          printf "\nTo patch suppression list run:\n\n"
          GIT_DIFF=$(git diff)
          printf "patch -p1 << EOF\n%s\nEOF" "$GIT_DIFF"
          exit 1

      - name: Stage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        run: |
          mkdir staging && cp -r target/pit-reports/ staging
          git diff && git diff > target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch

        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}-coverage-report
          path: |
            staging

          retention-days: 7

name: Pitest

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master

    branches: '*'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}

jobs:

        profile:
          - annotation
          - ant
          - api
          - blocks
          - coding-1
          - coding-2
          - coding-require-this-check
          - common
          - common-2
          - design
          - filters
          - header
          - imports
          - indentation
          - javadoc
          - main

          - misc
          - modifier
          - naming

          # GUI package needs better test coverage before adding to execution.

    continue-on-error: true
    steps:

        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: 11
          distribution: 'temurin'

      - name: Install groovy
        run: |

          sudo apt install groovy

      - name: Setup local maven cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.m2/repository
          key: checkstyle-maven-cache-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}

      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Generate pitest-${{ matrix.profile }} report
        run: |
          ./.ci/pitest.sh "pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}"

      - name: Patch command for pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}
        if: failure()
        run: |
          printf "\nTo patch suppression list run:\n\n"
          GIT_DIFF=$(git diff)
          printf "patch -p1 << EOF\n%s\nEOF" "$GIT_DIFF"
          exit 1

      - name: Stage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        run: |
          mkdir staging && cp -r target/pit-reports/ staging
          git diff && git diff > target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch

      - name: Archive code coverage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}-coverage-report
          path: |
            staging

          retention-days: 7

name: Pitest

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
  pull_request:
    branches: '*'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:
    if: github.repository == 'checkstyle/checkstyle'
    strategy:
      matrix:
        profile:
          - annotation
          - ant
          - api
          - blocks
          - coding-1
          - coding-2
          - coding-require-this-check
          - common
          - common-2
          - design
          - filters
          - header
          - imports
          - indentation
          - javadoc
          - main
          - metrics
          - misc
          - modifier
          - naming
          - packagenamesloader
          - regexp
          - sizes
          - tree-walker
          - utils
          - whitespace
          - xpath
          - java-ast-visitor
          # GUI package needs better test coverage before adding to execution.
          # - gui
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Set up JDK 11
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: 11
          distribution: 'temurin'

      - name: Install groovy
        run: |
          sudo apt update
          sudo apt install groovy

      - name: Setup local maven cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.m2/repository
          key: checkstyle-maven-cache-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}

      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Generate pitest-${{ matrix.profile }} report
        run: |
          ./.ci/pitest.sh "pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}"

      - name: Patch command for pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}
        if: failure()
        run: |
          printf "\nTo patch suppression list run:\n\n"
          GIT_DIFF=$(git diff)
          printf "patch -p1 << EOF\n%s\nEOF" "$GIT_DIFF"
          exit 1

      - name: Stage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        run: |
          mkdir staging && cp -r target/pit-reports/ staging
          git diff && git diff > target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch

      - name: Archive code coverage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}-coverage-report
          path: |
            staging
            target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch
          retention-days: 7

name: Pitest

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
  pull_request:
    branches: '*'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:
    if: github.repository == 'checkstyle/checkstyle'
    strategy:
      matrix:
        profile:
          - annotation
          - ant
          - api
          - blocks
          - coding-1
          - coding-2
          - coding-require-this-check
          - common
          - common-2
          - design
          - filters
          - header
          - imports
          - indentation
          - javadoc
          - main
          - metrics
          - misc
          - modifier
          - naming
          - packagenamesloader
          - regexp
          - sizes
          - tree-walker
          - utils
          - whitespace
          - xpath
          - java-ast-visitor
          # GUI package needs better test coverage before adding to execution.
          # - gui
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Set up JDK 11
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: 11
          distribution: 'temurin'

      - name: Install groovy
        run: |
          sudo apt update
          sudo apt install groovy

      - name: Setup local maven cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.m2/repository
          key: checkstyle-maven-cache-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}

      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Generate pitest-${{ matrix.profile }} report
        run: |
          ./.ci/pitest.sh "pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}"

      - name: Patch command for pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}
        if: failure()
        run: |
          printf "\nTo patch suppression list run:\n\n"
          GIT_DIFF=$(git diff)
          printf "patch -p1 << EOF\n%s\nEOF" "$GIT_DIFF"
          exit 1

      - name: Stage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        run: |
          mkdir staging && cp -r target/pit-reports/ staging
          git diff && git diff > target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch

      - name: Archive code coverage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}-coverage-report
          path: |
            staging
            target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch
          retention-days: 7

name: Pitest

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
  pull_request:
    branches: '*'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:
    if: github.repository == 'checkstyle/checkstyle'
    strategy:
      matrix:
        profile:
          - annotation
          - ant
          - api
          - blocks
          - coding-1
          - coding-2
          - coding-require-this-check
          - common
          - common-2
          - design
          - filters
          - header
          - imports
          - indentation
          - javadoc
          - main
          - metrics
          - misc
          - modifier
          - naming
          - packagenamesloader
          - regexp
          - sizes
          - tree-walker
          - utils
          - whitespace
          - xpath
          - java-ast-visitor
          # GUI package needs better test coverage before adding to execution.
          # - gui
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Set up JDK 11
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: 11
          distribution: 'temurin'

      - name: Install groovy
        run: |
          sudo apt update
          sudo apt install groovy

      - name: Setup local maven cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.m2/repository
          key: checkstyle-maven-cache-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}

      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Generate pitest-${{ matrix.profile }} report
        run: |
          ./.ci/pitest.sh "pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}"

      - name: Patch command for pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}
        if: failure()
        run: |
          printf "\nTo patch suppression list run:\n\n"
          GIT_DIFF=$(git diff)
          printf "patch -p1 << EOF\n%s\nEOF" "$GIT_DIFF"
          exit 1

      - name: Stage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        run: |
          mkdir staging && cp -r target/pit-reports/ staging
          git diff && git diff > target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch

      - name: Archive code coverage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}-coverage-report
          path: |
            staging
            target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch
          retention-days: 7

```dockerfile
FROM openjdk:17-slim  # Adjust the base image based on the project's requirements

# Avoid interruptive messages from tzdata
ENV TZ=Europe/Berlin
RUN ln -snf /usr/share/zoneinfo/$TZ /etc/localtime && echo $TZ > /etc/timezone

# Install git first, separately from other packages
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y git

# Install other relevant packages (e.g., Maven for building Java projects)
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y maven && \
    apt-get clean && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* || exit 0

WORKDIR /app

# Clone the repository
RUN git clone https://github.com/checkstyle/checkstyle.git || exit 0

WORKDIR /app/checkstyle

CMD ["/bin/bash"]
```

```bash

name: Pitest

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
  pull_request:
    branches: '*'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:
    if: github.repository == 'checkstyle/checkstyle'
    strategy:
      matrix:
        profile:
          - annotation
          - ant
          - api
          - blocks
          - coding-1
          - coding-2
          - coding-require-this-check
          - common
          - common-2
          - design
          - filters
          - header
          - imports
          - indentation
          - javadoc
          - main
          - metrics
          - misc
          - modifier
          - naming
          - packagenamesloader
          - regexp
          - sizes
          - tree-walker
          - utils
          - whitespace
          - xpath
          - java-ast-visitor
          # GUI package needs better test coverage before adding to execution.
          # - gui
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Set up JDK 11
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: 11
          distribution: 'temurin'

      - name: Install groovy
        run: |
          sudo apt update
          sudo apt install groovy

      - name: Setup local maven cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.m2/repository
          key: checkstyle-maven-cache-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}

      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Generate pitest-${{ matrix.profile }} report
        run: |
          ./.ci/pitest.sh "pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}"

      - name: Patch command for pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}
        if: failure()
        run: |
          printf "\nTo patch suppression list run:\n\n"
          GIT_DIFF=$(git diff)
          printf "patch -p1 << EOF\n%s\nEOF" "$GIT_DIFF"
          exit 1

      - name: Stage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        run: |
          mkdir staging && cp -r target/pit-reports/ staging
          git diff && git diff > target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch

      - name: Archive code coverage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}-coverage-report
          path: |
            staging
            target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch
          retention-days: 7

name: Pitest

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master

    branches: '*'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:

      matrix:
        profile:
          - annotation
          - ant
          - api
          - blocks
          - coding-1
          - coding-2
          - coding-require-this-check
          - common
          - common-2
          - design
          - filters
          - header
          - imports
          - indentation
          - javadoc
          - main
          - metrics
          - misc
          - modifier
          - naming
          - packagenamesloader
          - regexp
          - sizes
          - tree-walker
          - utils
          - whitespace
          - xpath
          - java-ast-visitor
          # GUI package needs better test coverage before adding to execution.
          # - gui
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Set up JDK 11
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: 11
          distribution: 'temurin'

      - name: Install groovy
        run: |
          sudo apt update
          sudo apt install groovy

      - name: Setup local maven cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.m2/repository
          key: checkstyle-maven-cache-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}

      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Generate pitest-${{ matrix.profile }} report
        run: |
          ./.ci/pitest.sh "pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}"

      - name: Patch command for pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}
        if: failure()
        run: |
          printf "\nTo patch suppression list run:\n\n"
          GIT_DIFF=$(git diff)
          printf "patch -p1 << EOF\n%s\nEOF" "$GIT_DIFF"
          exit 1

      - name: Stage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        run: |
          mkdir staging && cp -r target/pit-reports/ staging
          git diff && git diff > target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch

      - name: Archive code coverage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}-coverage-report
          path: |
            staging
            target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch
          retention-days: 7

on:

          - common

name: Pitest

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master

    branches: '*'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}

jobs:

          - annotation
          - ant
          - api
          - blocks
          - coding-1
          - coding-2
          - coding-require-this-check
          - common
          - common-2
          - design
          - filters

          - javadoc
          - main

        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: 11
          distribution: 'temurin'

      - name: Install groovy
        run: |

      - name: Setup local maven cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.m2/repository

      - name: Checkout

        run: |
          ./.ci/pitest.sh "pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}"

      - name: Patch command for pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}
        if: failure()
        run: |
          printf "\nTo patch suppression list run:\n\n"
          GIT_DIFF=$(git diff)
          printf "patch -p1 << EOF\n%s\nEOF" "$GIT_DIFF"
          exit 1

      - name: Stage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        run: |
          mkdir staging && cp -r target/pit-reports/ staging
          git diff && git diff > target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch

        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:

name: Pitest

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
  pull_request:
    branches: '*'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:
    if: github.repository == 'checkstyle/checkstyle'
    strategy:
      matrix:
        profile:
          - annotation
          - ant
          - api
          - blocks
          - coding-1
          - coding-2
          - coding-require-this-check
          - common
          - common-2
          - design
          - filters
          - header
          - imports
          - indentation
          - javadoc
          - main
          - metrics
          - misc
          - modifier
          - naming
          - packagenamesloader
          - regexp
          - sizes
          - tree-walker
          - utils
          - whitespace
          - xpath
          - java-ast-visitor
          # GUI package needs better test coverage before adding to execution.
          # - gui
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Set up JDK 11
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: 11
          distribution: 'temurin'

      - name: Install groovy
        run: |
          sudo apt update
          sudo apt install groovy

      - name: Setup local maven cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.m2/repository
          key: checkstyle-maven-cache-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}

      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Generate pitest-${{ matrix.profile }} report
        run: |
          ./.ci/pitest.sh "pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}"

      - name: Patch command for pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}
        if: failure()
        run: |
          printf "\nTo patch suppression list run:\n\n"
          GIT_DIFF=$(git diff)
          printf "patch -p1 << EOF\n%s\nEOF" "$GIT_DIFF"
          exit 1

      - name: Stage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        run: |
          mkdir staging && cp -r target/pit-reports/ staging
          git diff && git diff > target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch

      - name: Archive code coverage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}-coverage-report
          path: |
            staging
            target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch
          retention-days: 7

          - common

          - design

          - main

        run: |

      - name: Patch command for pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}
        if: failure()
        run: |
          printf "\nTo patch suppression list run:\n\n"
          GIT_DIFF=$(git diff)
          printf "patch -p1 << EOF\n%s\nEOF" "$GIT_DIFF"
          exit 1

      - name: Stage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        run: |

name: Pitest

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master

    branches: '*'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}

jobs:

    if: github.repository == 'checkstyle/checkstyle'

      matrix:
        profile:
          - annotation
          - ant
          - api
          - blocks
          - coding-1
          - coding-2
          - coding-require-this-check
          - common
          - common-2
          - design
          - filters

          - javadoc
          - main

        with:

          distribution: 'temurin'

        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:

name: Pitest

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master

    branches: '*'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}

jobs:

        profile:
          - annotation
          - ant
          - api
          - blocks
          - coding-1
          - coding-2
          - coding-require-this-check
          - common
          - common-2
          - design
          - filters
          - header
          - imports
          - indentation
          - javadoc
          - main

          - misc
          - modifier
          - naming

          # GUI package needs better test coverage before adding to execution.

    continue-on-error: true
    steps:

        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: 11
          distribution: 'temurin'

      - name: Install groovy
        run: |
          sudo apt update
          sudo apt install groovy

      - name: Setup local maven cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.m2/repository
          key: checkstyle-maven-cache-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}

      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

        run: |
          ./.ci/pitest.sh "pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}"

      - name: Patch command for pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}
        if: failure()
        run: |
          printf "\nTo patch suppression list run:\n\n"
          GIT_DIFF=$(git diff)
          printf "patch -p1 << EOF\n%s\nEOF" "$GIT_DIFF"
          exit 1

      - name: Stage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        run: |
          mkdir staging && cp -r target/pit-reports/ staging
          git diff && git diff > target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch

      - name: Archive code coverage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}-coverage-report
          path: |
            staging
            target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch

name: Pitest

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
  pull_request:
    branches: '*'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:
    if: github.repository == 'checkstyle/checkstyle'
    strategy:
      matrix:
        profile:
          - annotation
          - ant
          - api
          - blocks
          - coding-1
          - coding-2
          - coding-require-this-check
          - common
          - common-2
          - design
          - filters
          - header
          - imports
          - indentation
          - javadoc
          - main
          - metrics
          - misc
          - modifier
          - naming
          - packagenamesloader
          - regexp
          - sizes
          - tree-walker
          - utils
          - whitespace
          - xpath
          - java-ast-visitor
          # GUI package needs better test coverage before adding to execution.
          # - gui
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Set up JDK 11
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: 11
          distribution: 'temurin'

      - name: Install groovy
        run: |
          sudo apt update
          sudo apt install groovy

      - name: Setup local maven cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.m2/repository
          key: checkstyle-maven-cache-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}

      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Generate pitest-${{ matrix.profile }} report
        run: |
          ./.ci/pitest.sh "pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}"

      - name: Patch command for pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}
        if: failure()
        run: |
          printf "\nTo patch suppression list run:\n\n"
          GIT_DIFF=$(git diff)
          printf "patch -p1 << EOF\n%s\nEOF" "$GIT_DIFF"
          exit 1

      - name: Stage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        run: |
          mkdir staging && cp -r target/pit-reports/ staging
          git diff && git diff > target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch

      - name: Archive code coverage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}-coverage-report
          path: |
            staging
            target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch
          retention-days: 7

name: Pitest

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
  pull_request:
    branches: '*'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:
    if: github.repository == 'checkstyle/checkstyle'
    strategy:
      matrix:
        profile:
          - annotation
          - ant
          - api
          - blocks
          - coding-1
          - coding-2
          - coding-require-this-check
          - common
          - common-2
          - design
          - filters
          - header
          - imports
          - indentation
          - javadoc
          - main
          - metrics
          - misc
          - modifier
          - naming
          - packagenamesloader
          - regexp
          - sizes
          - tree-walker
          - utils
          - whitespace
          - xpath
          - java-ast-visitor
          # GUI package needs better test coverage before adding to execution.
          # - gui
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Set up JDK 11
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: 11
          distribution: 'temurin'

      - name: Install groovy
        run: |
          sudo apt update
          sudo apt install groovy

      - name: Setup local maven cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.m2/repository
          key: checkstyle-maven-cache-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}

      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Generate pitest-${{ matrix.profile }} report
        run: |
          ./.ci/pitest.sh "pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}"

      - name: Patch command for pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}
        if: failure()
        run: |
          printf "\nTo patch suppression list run:\n\n"
          GIT_DIFF=$(git diff)
          printf "patch -p1 << EOF\n%s\nEOF" "$GIT_DIFF"
          exit 1

      - name: Stage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        run: |
          mkdir staging && cp -r target/pit-reports/ staging
          git diff && git diff > target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch

      - name: Archive code coverage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}-coverage-report
          path: |
            staging
            target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch
          retention-days: 7

name: Pitest

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
  pull_request:
    branches: '*'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:
    if: github.repository == 'checkstyle/checkstyle'
    strategy:
      matrix:
        profile:
          - annotation
          - ant
          - api
          - blocks
          - coding-1
          - coding-2
          - coding-require-this-check
          - common
          - common-2
          - design
          - filters
          - header
          - imports
          - indentation
          - javadoc
          - main
          - metrics
          - misc
          - modifier
          - naming
          - packagenamesloader
          - regexp
          - sizes
          - tree-walker
          - utils
          - whitespace
          - xpath
          - java-ast-visitor
          # GUI package needs better test coverage before adding to execution.
          # - gui
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Set up JDK 11
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: 11
          distribution: 'temurin'

      - name: Install groovy
        run: |
          sudo apt update
          sudo apt install groovy

      - name: Setup local maven cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.m2/repository
          key: checkstyle-maven-cache-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}

      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Generate pitest-${{ matrix.profile }} report
        run: |
          ./.ci/pitest.sh "pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}"

      - name: Patch command for pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}
        if: failure()
        run: |
          printf "\nTo patch suppression list run:\n\n"
          GIT_DIFF=$(git diff)
          printf "patch -p1 << EOF\n%s\nEOF" "$GIT_DIFF"
          exit 1

      - name: Stage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        run: |
          mkdir staging && cp -r target/pit-reports/ staging
          git diff && git diff > target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch

      - name: Archive code coverage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}-coverage-report
          path: |
            staging
            target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch
          retention-days: 7

name: Pitest

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
  pull_request:
    branches: '*'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:
    if: github.repository == 'checkstyle/checkstyle'
    strategy:
      matrix:
        profile:
          - annotation
          - ant
          - api
          - blocks
          - coding-1
          - coding-2
          - coding-require-this-check
          - common
          - common-2
          - design
          - filters
          - header
          - imports
          - indentation
          - javadoc
          - main
          - metrics
          - misc
          - modifier
          - naming
          - packagenamesloader
          - regexp
          - sizes
          - tree-walker
          - utils
          - whitespace
          - xpath
          - java-ast-visitor
          # GUI package needs better test coverage before adding to execution.
          # - gui
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Set up JDK 11
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: 11
          distribution: 'temurin'

      - name: Install groovy
        run: |
          sudo apt update
          sudo apt install groovy

      - name: Setup local maven cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.m2/repository
          key: checkstyle-maven-cache-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}

      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Generate pitest-${{ matrix.profile }} report
        run: |
          ./.ci/pitest.sh "pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}"

      - name: Patch command for pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}
        if: failure()
        run: |
          printf "\nTo patch suppression list run:\n\n"
          GIT_DIFF=$(git diff)
          printf "patch -p1 << EOF\n%s\nEOF" "$GIT_DIFF"
          exit 1

      - name: Stage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        run: |
          mkdir staging && cp -r target/pit-reports/ staging
          git diff && git diff > target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch

      - name: Archive code coverage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}-coverage-report
          path: |
            staging
            target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch
          retention-days: 7

name: Pitest

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
  pull_request:
    branches: '*'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:
    if: github.repository == 'checkstyle/checkstyle'
    strategy:
      matrix:
        profile:
          - annotation
          - ant
          - api
          - blocks
          - coding-1
          - coding-2
          - coding-require-this-check
          - common
          - common-2
          - design
          - filters
          - header
          - imports
          - indentation
          - javadoc
          - main
          - metrics
          - misc
          - modifier
          - naming
          - packagenamesloader
          - regexp
          - sizes
          - tree-walker
          - utils
          - whitespace
          - xpath
          - java-ast-visitor
          # GUI package needs better test coverage before adding to execution.
          # - gui
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Set up JDK 11
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: 11
          distribution: 'temurin'

      - name: Install groovy
        run: |
          sudo apt update
          sudo apt install groovy

      - name: Setup local maven cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.m2/repository
          key: checkstyle-maven-cache-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}

      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Generate pitest-${{ matrix.profile }} report
        run: |
          ./.ci/pitest.sh "pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}"

      - name: Patch command for pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}
        if: failure()
        run: |
          printf "\nTo patch suppression list run:\n\n"
          GIT_DIFF=$(git diff)
          printf "patch -p1 << EOF\n%s\nEOF" "$GIT_DIFF"
          exit 1

      - name: Stage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        run: |
          mkdir staging && cp -r target/pit-reports/ staging
          git diff && git diff > target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch

      - name: Archive code coverage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}-coverage-report
          path: |
            staging
            target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch
          retention-days: 7

name: Pitest

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
  pull_request:
    branches: '*'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:
    if: github.repository == 'checkstyle/checkstyle'
    strategy:
      matrix:
        profile:
          - annotation
          - ant
          - api
          - blocks
          - coding-1
          - coding-2
          - coding-require-this-check
          - common
          - common-2
          - design
          - filters
          - header
          - imports
          - indentation
          - javadoc
          - main
          - metrics
          - misc
          - modifier
          - naming
          - packagenamesloader
          - regexp
          - sizes
          - tree-walker
          - utils
          - whitespace
          - xpath
          - java-ast-visitor
          # GUI package needs better test coverage before adding to execution.
          # - gui
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Set up JDK 11
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: 11
          distribution: 'temurin'

      - name: Install groovy
        run: |
          sudo apt update
          sudo apt install groovy

      - name: Setup local maven cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.m2/repository
          key: checkstyle-maven-cache-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}

      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Generate pitest-${{ matrix.profile }} report
        run: |
          ./.ci/pitest.sh "pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}"

      - name: Patch command for pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}
        if: failure()
        run: |
          printf "\nTo patch suppression list run:\n\n"
          GIT_DIFF=$(git diff)
          printf "patch -p1 << EOF\n%s\nEOF" "$GIT_DIFF"
          exit 1

      - name: Stage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        run: |
          mkdir staging && cp -r target/pit-reports/ staging
          git diff && git diff > target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch

      - name: Archive code coverage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}-coverage-report
          path: |
            staging
            target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch
          retention-days: 7

name: Pitest

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master

    branches: '*'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:
    if: github.repository == 'checkstyle/checkstyle'
    strategy:
      matrix:
        profile:
          - annotation
          - ant
          - api
          - blocks
          - coding-1
          - coding-2
          - coding-require-this-check
          - common
          - common-2
          - design
          - filters
          - header
          - imports
          - indentation
          - javadoc
          - main
          - metrics
          - misc
          - modifier
          - naming
          - packagenamesloader
          - regexp
          - sizes
          - tree-walker
          - utils
          - whitespace
          - xpath
          - java-ast-visitor
          # GUI package needs better test coverage before adding to execution.
          # - gui
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Set up JDK 11
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: 11
          distribution: 'temurin'

      - name: Install groovy
        run: |
          sudo apt update
          sudo apt install groovy

      - name: Setup local maven cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.m2/repository
          key: checkstyle-maven-cache-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}

      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Generate pitest-${{ matrix.profile }} report
        run: |
          ./.ci/pitest.sh "pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}"

      - name: Patch command for pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}
        if: failure()
        run: |
          printf "\nTo patch suppression list run:\n\n"
          GIT_DIFF=$(git diff)
          printf "patch -p1 << EOF\n%s\nEOF" "$GIT_DIFF"
          exit 1

      - name: Stage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        run: |
          mkdir staging && cp -r target/pit-reports/ staging
          git diff && git diff > target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch

      - name: Archive code coverage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}-coverage-report
          path: |
            staging
            target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch
          retention-days: 7

name: Pitest

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
  pull_request:
    branches: '*'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:
    if: github.repository == 'checkstyle/checkstyle'
    strategy:
      matrix:
        profile:
          - annotation
          - ant
          - api
          - blocks
          - coding-1
          - coding-2
          - coding-require-this-check
          - common
          - common-2
          - design
          - filters
          - header
          - imports
          - indentation
          - javadoc
          - main
          - metrics
          - misc
          - modifier
          - naming
          - packagenamesloader
          - regexp
          - sizes
          - tree-walker
          - utils
          - whitespace
          - xpath
          - java-ast-visitor
          # GUI package needs better test coverage before adding to execution.
          # - gui
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Set up JDK 11
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: 11
          distribution: 'temurin'

      - name: Install groovy
        run: |
          sudo apt update
          sudo apt install groovy

      - name: Setup local maven cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.m2/repository
          key: checkstyle-maven-cache-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}

      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Generate pitest-${{ matrix.profile }} report
        run: |
          ./.ci/pitest.sh "pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}"

      - name: Patch command for pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}
        if: failure()
        run: |
          printf "\nTo patch suppression list run:\n\n"
          GIT_DIFF=$(git diff)
          printf "patch -p1 << EOF\n%s\nEOF" "$GIT_DIFF"
          exit 1

      - name: Stage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        run: |
          mkdir staging && cp -r target/pit-reports/ staging
          git diff && git diff > target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch

      - name: Archive code coverage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}-coverage-report
          path: |
            staging
            target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch
          retention-days: 7

1. **Dockerfile Creation**: You will need to create a Dockerfile that outlines the environment setup for the Checkstyle project. Here is a template you can use:

```dockerfile
FROM openjdk:17-slim  # Adjust the base image based on the project's requirements

# Avoid interruptive messages from tzdata
ENV TZ=Europe/Berlin
RUN ln -snf /usr/share/zoneinfo/$TZ /etc/localtime && echo $TZ > /etc/timezone

# Install git first, separately from other packages
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y git

# Install other relevant packages (e.g., Maven for building Java projects)
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y maven && \
    apt-get clean && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* || exit 0

WORKDIR /app

# Clone the repository
RUN git clone https://github.com/checkstyle/checkstyle.git || exit 0

WORKDIR /app/checkstyle

CMD ["/bin/bash"]
```

2. **Build the Docker Image**: The Docker image can be built by writing the above Dockerfile to a file and then triggering the process automatically. No manual docker commands should be issued in the terminal.

3. **After Launching the Docker Container**:
    - Install required system packages and necessary language runtimes if not included in the Dockerfile.
    - Use Maven to install any Java-specific dependencies as specified in the project documentation.

Example of a Maven command to build the project:
```bash
mvn clean install
```

4. **Running the Test Suite**: Once the project is built successfully, you can run the tests using:
```bash
mvn test
```

5. **Important Notes**:
   - Do **not** add `|| exit 0` to commands run directly in the terminal. It should only be used in the RUN instructions within the Dockerfile.
   - Always check for the project's specific requirements regarding dependencies and configurations in their documentation.
   - Ensure that the Dockerfile correctly sets up the environment, as missing steps can lead to build failures.

name: Pitest

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master

    branches: '*'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}

          - annotation
          - ant

          - blocks
          - coding-1

          - common
          - common-2
          - design

          - main

          - whitespace
          - xpath

          # GUI package needs better test coverage before adding to execution.

        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: 11
          distribution: 'temurin'

      - name: Setup local maven cache

      - name: Checkout

        run: |
          ./.ci/pitest.sh "pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}"

      - name: Patch command for pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}
        if: failure()
        run: |
          printf "\nTo patch suppression list run:\n\n"
          GIT_DIFF=$(git diff)
          printf "patch -p1 << EOF\n%s\nEOF" "$GIT_DIFF"
          exit 1

      - name: Stage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        run: |
          mkdir staging && cp -r target/pit-reports/ staging
          git diff && git diff > target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch

        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}-coverage-report
          path: |
            staging

name: Pitest

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
  pull_request:
    branches: '*'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:
    if: github.repository == 'checkstyle/checkstyle'
    strategy:
      matrix:
        profile:
          - annotation
          - ant
          - api
          - blocks
          - coding-1
          - coding-2
          - coding-require-this-check
          - common
          - common-2
          - design
          - filters
          - header
          - imports
          - indentation
          - javadoc
          - main
          - metrics
          - misc
          - modifier
          - naming
          - packagenamesloader
          - regexp
          - sizes
          - tree-walker
          - utils
          - whitespace
          - xpath
          - java-ast-visitor
          # GUI package needs better test coverage before adding to execution.
          # - gui
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Set up JDK 11
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: 11
          distribution: 'temurin'

      - name: Install groovy
        run: |
          sudo apt update
          sudo apt install groovy

      - name: Setup local maven cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.m2/repository
          key: checkstyle-maven-cache-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}

      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Generate pitest-${{ matrix.profile }} report
        run: |
          ./.ci/pitest.sh "pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}"

      - name: Patch command for pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}
        if: failure()
        run: |
          printf "\nTo patch suppression list run:\n\n"
          GIT_DIFF=$(git diff)
          printf "patch -p1 << EOF\n%s\nEOF" "$GIT_DIFF"
          exit 1

      - name: Stage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        run: |
          mkdir staging && cp -r target/pit-reports/ staging
          git diff && git diff > target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch

      - name: Archive code coverage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}-coverage-report
          path: |
            staging
            target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch
          retention-days: 7

name: Pitest

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master

    branches: '*'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}

jobs:
  test:
    if: github.repository == 'checkstyle/checkstyle'

      matrix:
        profile:
          - annotation
          - ant
          - api
          - blocks
          - coding-1
          - coding-2
          - coding-require-this-check
          - common
          - common-2
          - design
          - filters
          - header
          - imports
          - indentation
          - javadoc
          - main
          - metrics
          - misc
          - modifier
          - naming
          - packagenamesloader
          - regexp
          - sizes
          - tree-walker
          - utils
          - whitespace
          - xpath
          - java-ast-visitor
          # GUI package needs better test coverage before adding to execution.
          # - gui
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Set up JDK 11
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: 11
          distribution: 'temurin'

      - name: Install groovy
        run: |
          sudo apt update
          sudo apt install groovy

      - name: Setup local maven cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.m2/repository
          key: checkstyle-maven-cache-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}

      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Generate pitest-${{ matrix.profile }} report
        run: |
          ./.ci/pitest.sh "pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}"

      - name: Patch command for pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}
        if: failure()
        run: |
          printf "\nTo patch suppression list run:\n\n"
          GIT_DIFF=$(git diff)
          printf "patch -p1 << EOF\n%s\nEOF" "$GIT_DIFF"
          exit 1

      - name: Stage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        run: |
          mkdir staging && cp -r target/pit-reports/ staging
          git diff && git diff > target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch

      - name: Archive code coverage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}-coverage-report
          path: |
            staging
            target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch
          retention-days: 7

name: Pitest

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
  pull_request:
    branches: '*'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:
    if: github.repository == 'checkstyle/checkstyle'
    strategy:
      matrix:
        profile:
          - annotation
          - ant
          - api
          - blocks
          - coding-1
          - coding-2
          - coding-require-this-check
          - common
          - common-2
          - design
          - filters
          - header
          - imports
          - indentation
          - javadoc
          - main
          - metrics
          - misc
          - modifier
          - naming
          - packagenamesloader
          - regexp
          - sizes
          - tree-walker
          - utils
          - whitespace
          - xpath
          - java-ast-visitor
          # GUI package needs better test coverage before adding to execution.
          # - gui
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Set up JDK 11
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: 11
          distribution: 'temurin'

      - name: Install groovy
        run: |
          sudo apt update
          sudo apt install groovy

      - name: Setup local maven cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.m2/repository
          key: checkstyle-maven-cache-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}

      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Generate pitest-${{ matrix.profile }} report
        run: |
          ./.ci/pitest.sh "pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}"

      - name: Patch command for pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}
        if: failure()
        run: |
          printf "\nTo patch suppression list run:\n\n"
          GIT_DIFF=$(git diff)
          printf "patch -p1 << EOF\n%s\nEOF" "$GIT_DIFF"
          exit 1

      - name: Stage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        run: |
          mkdir staging && cp -r target/pit-reports/ staging
          git diff && git diff > target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch

      - name: Archive code coverage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}-coverage-report
          path: |
            staging
            target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch
          retention-days: 7

name: Pitest

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master

    branches: '*'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:
    if: github.repository == 'checkstyle/checkstyle'

      matrix:
        profile:
          - annotation
          - ant
          - api
          - blocks
          - coding-1
          - coding-2
          - coding-require-this-check
          - common
          - common-2
          - design
          - filters
          - header
          - imports
          - indentation
          - javadoc
          - main
          - metrics
          - misc
          - modifier
          - naming
          - packagenamesloader
          - regexp
          - sizes
          - tree-walker
          - utils
          - whitespace
          - xpath
          - java-ast-visitor
          # GUI package needs better test coverage before adding to execution.

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Set up JDK 11
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: 11
          distribution: 'temurin'

      - name: Install groovy
        run: |
          sudo apt update
          sudo apt install groovy

      - name: Setup local maven cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.m2/repository
          key: checkstyle-maven-cache-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}

      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Generate pitest-${{ matrix.profile }} report
        run: |
          ./.ci/pitest.sh "pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}"

      - name: Patch command for pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}
        if: failure()
        run: |
          printf "\nTo patch suppression list run:\n\n"
          GIT_DIFF=$(git diff)
          printf "patch -p1 << EOF\n%s\nEOF" "$GIT_DIFF"
          exit 1

      - name: Stage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        run: |
          mkdir staging && cp -r target/pit-reports/ staging
          git diff && git diff > target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch

      - name: Archive code coverage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}-coverage-report
          path: |
            staging
            target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch
          retention-days: 7

name: Pitest

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master

    branches: '*'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}

      matrix:
        profile:
          - annotation
          - ant
          - api
          - blocks
          - coding-1
          - coding-2
          - coding-require-this-check
          - common
          - common-2
          - design
          - filters

          - javadoc
          - main

        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: 11
          distribution: 'temurin'

      - name: Install groovy

          sudo apt install groovy

      - name: Setup local maven cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:

      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Patch command for pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}
        if: failure()
        run: |
          printf "\nTo patch suppression list run:\n\n"

        run: |
          mkdir staging && cp -r target/pit-reports/ staging
          git diff && git diff > target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch

        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}-coverage-report
          path: |
            staging

**General Guidelines for Java Projects**

1. **Read the README**  
   Start by reading the project's README file on GitHub. It often contains important instructions for installation, usage, and any project-specific details.  

2. **Check Dependencies**  
   Look for any dependencies listed in the README or in configuration files like `pom.xml` (for Maven) or `build.gradle` (for Gradle). Ensure you have the required JDK version installed.  

3. **Build Tool**  
   Identify which build tool the project is using: Maven or Gradle. This information should be available in the README or through project configuration files (`pom.xml` for Maven, `build.gradle` for Gradle).  

4. **Build the Project**  
   Use the appropriate commands based on the build tool:

     ```  
     mvn clean install

   - For Gradle:  
     ```  
     gradle build

   Follow the instructions in the README to run the project. This could involve running a specific class, starting a server, or executing a specific command.

   If you encounter any issues during installation or while running the project, refer to the project’s issue tracker on GitHub or search for similar issues others may have encountered.

name: Pitest

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
  pull_request:
    branches: '*'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:
    if: github.repository == 'checkstyle/checkstyle'
    strategy:
      matrix:
        profile:
          - annotation
          - ant
          - api
          - blocks
          - coding-1
          - coding-2
          - coding-require-this-check
          - common
          - common-2
          - design
          - filters
          - header
          - imports
          - indentation
          - javadoc
          - main
          - metrics
          - misc
          - modifier
          - naming
          - packagenamesloader
          - regexp
          - sizes
          - tree-walker
          - utils
          - whitespace
          - xpath
          - java-ast-visitor
          # GUI package needs better test coverage before adding to execution.
          # - gui
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Set up JDK 11
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: 11
          distribution: 'temurin'

      - name: Install groovy
        run: |
          sudo apt update
          sudo apt install groovy

      - name: Setup local maven cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.m2/repository
          key: checkstyle-maven-cache-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}

      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Generate pitest-${{ matrix.profile }} report
        run: |
          ./.ci/pitest.sh "pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}"

      - name: Patch command for pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}
        if: failure()
        run: |
          printf "\nTo patch suppression list run:\n\n"
          GIT_DIFF=$(git diff)
          printf "patch -p1 << EOF\n%s\nEOF" "$GIT_DIFF"
          exit 1

      - name: Stage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        run: |
          mkdir staging && cp -r target/pit-reports/ staging
          git diff && git diff > target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch

      - name: Archive code coverage results
        if: failure() || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}-coverage-report
          path: |
            staging
            target/pitest-${{ matrix.profile }}.patch
          retention-days: 7

name: Pitest

on:
  push:

      - master

    branches: '*'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}

jobs:

      matrix:
        profile:
          - annotation
          - ant
          - api
          - blocks
          - coding-1
          - coding-2
          - coding-require-this-check
          - common
          - common-2
          - design
          - filters

          - main

          # GUI package needs better test coverage before adding to execution.

    steps:

        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: 11
          distribution: 'temurin'

      - name: Install groovy

      - name: Setup local maven cache

        with:
